# ClickPDF

> A browser-based PDF toolkit by Click Digital Services.

## Overview

ClickPDF provides tools for merging, splitting, compressing, converting, organizing, editing, and protecting PDF documents. PDF file processing is performed in the browser for supported tools; the website may still load page resources and enabled third-party services. Device and browser limits apply.

## PDF tools

- [Merge PDF Files Online — 100% Free & In-Browser](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/merge-pdf/): Merge PDF files together online 100% free and client-side. Combine multiple PDFs into one document with drag-and-drop reordering and zero server uploads.
- [Split PDF Online — Extract Pages into Separate Files Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/split-pdf/): Split PDF files into individual pages or custom page ranges for free. Fast, client-side extraction in your browser with zero server uploads and 100% privacy.
- [Compress PDF Online — Reduce File Size 100% In-Browser](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/compress-pdf/): Reduce PDF file size online without compromising readability. Free, client-side PDF compression in your browser with zero server uploads and complete privacy.
- [Convert Images to PDF Online — JPG, PNG & WebP to PDF](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/image-to-pdf/): Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images to high-resolution PDF documents online for free. Fast, in-browser conversion with zero server uploads and custom orientation.
- [Convert PDF to Images Online — Export PDF Pages as PNG](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/pdf-to-image/): Convert PDF pages to PNG images in your browser. Add multiple PDFs, reorder, rotate, copy or remove pages, then download images in a ZIP with a folder for each document.
- [Rotate PDF Online — Permanently Rotate PDF Pages Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/rotate-pdf/): Rotate individual pages or entire PDF documents clockwise or counter-clockwise online. Free in-browser PDF rotation with instant visual preview and zero server uploads.
- [Watermark PDF Online — Add Confidential & Custom Marks Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/watermark-pdf/): Add custom text watermarks to your PDF documents online for free. Adjust text, opacity, angle, and position in your browser with zero server uploads.
- [Add Page Numbers to PDF Online — Free In-Browser Pagination](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/page-numbers-pdf/): Insert dynamic page numbering (e.g. Page 1 of N) into PDF headers or footers online for free. Clean, client-side pagination with zero server uploads.
- [Organize PDF Pages Online — Reorder, Rotate & Delete Pages](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/organize-pdf/): Visually reorder, delete, and rotate pages in any PDF document online for free. Drag-and-drop page sorting in your browser with zero server uploads.
- [Edit PDF Metadata Online — Modify Author, Title & Properties](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/edit-pdf-metadata/): Inspect, edit, or wipe PDF document properties like Title, Author, Subject, and Producer online for free. 100% in-browser editing with zero server uploads.
- [In-Browser PDF OCR, Page Counter & Text Analysis](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/ocr-pdf-analysis/): Extract text from scanned PDF images using in-browser Tesseract.js OCR, count pages, and inspect document dimensions 100% locally with zero server uploads.
- [Protect PDF Online — Web Crypto AES-256 Password Encryption](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/protect-pdf-password/): Password protect and encrypt PDF files using military-grade browser Web Crypto AES-256. 100% in-browser security with zero server uploads and zero password transmission.
- [Unlock PDF Online — Decrypt Password-Protected Documents Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/unlock-pdf-password/): Unlock and decrypt password-protected PDF files online for free. Fast, client-side Web Crypto decryption in your browser with zero server uploads.
- [Convert PDF to Text & Markdown Online — Free Text Extraction](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/pdf-to-text/): Extract formatted plain text and markdown from PDF documents online for free. Fast in-browser text extraction with zero server uploads and 100% privacy.
- [PDF to Word (DOCX) Converter — 100% Free & In-Browser](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/pdf-to-word/): Convert PDF to editable Microsoft Word (.docx) online 100% free with genuine text extraction, headings, and formatting. Private client-side conversion with zero server uploads.
- [PDF to Excel (XLSX) Converter — Extract Tables Online Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/pdf-to-excel/): Convert PDF tables, financial statements, and receipts to Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) online for free. In-browser coordinate grid detection with zero server uploads.
- [PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX) Converter — 100% Free & In-Browser](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/pdf-to-powerpoint/): Convert PDF pages to editable Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx) slides online 100% free. 16:9 widescreen presentation layout, editable text shapes, and zero server uploads.
- [Word to PDF Converter Online — Free DOCX to PDF In-Browser](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/word-to-pdf/): Convert Word (.docx) documents to readable, high-resolution PDF pages in your browser. Tables, lists, and embedded images are supported locally.
- [Word to Excel Converter — Extract DOCX Tables to XLSX](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/word-to-excel/): Extract tables and document text from Word (.docx) files into an Excel workbook in your browser. Each table gets its own worksheet; no server upload.
- [Excel to PDF Converter Online — Paginated Tables Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/excel-to-pdf/): Convert Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xls, .csv) to styled landscape PDF tables online 100% free. Auto-fit columns, zebra stripes, and zero server uploads.
- [Add a Visual Signature to PDF — Draw, Type or Upload](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/sign-pdf-online/): Draw, type, or upload a visual signature mark and embed it into PDF pages in your browser. Files and signature images stay on your device.
